title: 아직은 됐어
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie Bossa Nova. Nylon string acoustic guitar plays syncopated jazz chords with thumb-plucked bass notes. A clean electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with light chorus and reverb. Upright bass follows a traditional bossa nova two-beat pattern. Percussion consists of a shaker and a brushed snare drum hitting rimshots on the off-beats. Female vocals are delivered in a breathy, intimate head voice with minimal vibrato. The tempo is 92 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of C Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[nylon string acoustic guitar, shaker, brushed snare]

[Verse 1]
[breathy female vocals]
창가에 앉아서 [clean electric guitar enters]
오후 세 시야
햇살이 커피잔에
동그라미 그려

[Verse 2]
설탕은 안 넣었어
쓴맛이 좋아
오늘은 그래
책 한 장 넘겨
글씨가 안 읽혀
괜찮아 안 읽어도

[Chorus]
아무것도 안 해
그게 좋아 [electric guitar melodic fill]
